title: Red Hat Security Advisory: dnsmasq security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in the dnsmasq packages used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.4. These include heap buffer overflows, infinite loops, out-of-bounds reads, and source validation bypasses affecting DNS and DHCP functionalities. The update also includes a new DNSSEC trust anchor key for 2024.
